vendors.name: Delinea Secret Server
vendors.offering: Enterprise-grade privileged vault with discovery, password rotation and session monitoring

vendors.name: ManageEngine PAM360 Cloud

vendors.pricing: Community free up to 5,000 assets; Enterprise tiers by asset count, price not public

vendors.name: Teleport

vendors.name: Microsoft Entra ID P2 (PIM)
vendors.offering: Just-in-time privileged role activation for Entra/Azure roles
vendors.pricing: $10.00 per user/month paid yearly; select PIM in P2, full PIM in ID Governance

paid_market_gaps.gap: Small public bodies (~100 users) run full PAM tenders; leaders are quote-only with heavy implementation costs
Opaque, quote-only pricing from leaders (CyberArk, KeeperPAM, Delinea) complicates budgeting and tender comparison
CyberArk renewals seen as expensive versus competitors, with hard budget justification; Palo Alto ownership adds packaging uncertainty
Session management, JIT and vendor access sold as add-ons above business tiers, raising SMB cost

wtp_evidence: Devolutions lists packages at $48-650/user/year; CyberArk users call it very expensive yet keep paying; Palo Alto bought CyberArk for $2.3B cash plus 112M shares.
bundling_note: Entra ID P2 includes select PIM and AWS Session Manager is free on EC2, but cross-platform vaulting, rotation and session recording for on-prem estates remain paid.
summary: Crowded, consolidating market with strong spend. Only a narrow opening: transparent, quickly deployable PAM for small public-sector and mid-size buyers in tenders, or sovereign self-hosted EU offerings; competing against PAM360, Devolutions and JumpServer.
